parameters.help_en:
The switchover time. Valid values:
0: immediately.
1: within the O&M window
parameters.help_zh:
切换时间
0: 立即执行
1: 在运维时间内执行
parameters.name: switch_time_mode

parameters.help_en: The switchover start time. The switchover time range is [start time T, T+30m]. This parameter is not yet available
parameters.help_zh: 切换开始时间，切换时间为：[开始时间T, T+30m]，暂未开放使用
parameters.name: switch_time

parameters.help_en:
The target disk size for the specification change.

If the instance uses a fixed-size disk, the disk cannot be changed. In this case, do not specify DnStorageSpace.
Valid values of DnStorageSpace: [20, 3072]
parameters.help_zh:
变配目标磁盘大小

实例为固定大小磁盘时，不能变配磁盘，此时不传 DnStorageSpace
DnStorageSpace 范围：[20, 3072]
parameters.name: dn_storage_space

parameters.help_en: Set this parameter to cloud_auto when migrating from local disks to cloud disks. If this parameter is not specified, the storage type remains unchanged
parameters.help_zh: 本地盘迁云盘时传cloud_auto；不传表示不变更存储类型
parameters.name: storage_type
